name: Drinks counted by hand
summary: Takes the drinks count a bar or cellar does by hand, checks each line against the system count in the venue's POS, and posts the counts to the POS once a person approves them. Crons read and record; a person approves every change to stock.

covered_by.count-schedule: snapshot cron (system levels every 6 hours); the owner sets the count day
covered_by.physical-count: skill (the owner's count sheet becomes a count record)

crons.name: snapshot
crons.summary: Read the system stock of each tracked drink at each active venue location.

crons.name: reconcile
crons.summary: Compare each new hand count with the current system count and write the differences.

crons.name: post-counts
crons.summary: Queue each reconciled count as physical counts in the POS, for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only: the locations, the tracked drink items and their system stock. The POS changes only through the live operation, a physical-count batch, which waits for a person's approval in the CRM shell.

square.covers: locations, tracked item stock, physical counts posted for approval

gaps: Eats365 and Lightspeed: their docs describe stock features but the kit maps no API operation for either, so there is no adapter. Confirm an API operation list before building one.

Count sheet: no adapter reads a paper, Excel or form count sheet yet. Counts reach the workflow as count records in the counts store, written from the owner's sheet; a Microsoft 365 workbook adapter would replace that step.
Sales against usage (theoretical usage from POS sales and recipes): not built. The platform docs describe it only as a manual reconciliation.
Reorder and par levels: Square holds no par levels here and no reorder suggestion is built.
Deliveries and supplier invoices (receive-delivery, invoice-match): not built; AirPurchase and supplier invoices are outside the mapped platforms.
Transfers and waste: Square transfer order endpoints are mapped in the kit but this workflow does not use them; waste shows up only as a lower count.
Square endpoints are offline-tested only (platform status spec in core/sdk/platforms/square/platform.json); no sandbox account has run them yet.
